articles.summary: Flowco Holdings Inc. (NYSE: FLOC) (“Flowco” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a $150 million increase to the Company’s existing share repurchase program, bringing the total authorization to $200 million of the Company’s Class A common stock. The expanded program has no expiration date. Prior to the increase in the authorization, the Company had repurchased approximately $31.5 million under the existing share repurchase program. Joe Bob Edwards, President and Chief Executive Officer of Flowco, commented, “The Board’s approval of an increase in our share repurchase authorization to $200 million reflects our shared confidence in Flowco’s business model, financial strength and long-term outlook.
